name: Health Potion
description: A vial of red liquid that restores 30 HP when consumed.

name: Major Health Potion
description: A large vial of deep crimson liquid that restores 80 HP.
flavor_text: Thick enough to feel the life rushing back.

name: Mana Potion
description: A vial of blue liquid that restores 20 MP when consumed.
flavor_text: The universe distilled into a gulp.

name: Major Mana Potion
description: A vial of radiant sapphire liquid that restores 60 MP.
flavor_text: Drink it and feel the arcane flood back in.

name: Ancient Tome
description: A tome of indecipherable script that seems to rewrite itself when you aren't looking. The System cannot categorize it.
flavor_text: Some knowledge predates the System itself.

name: Coin of Fate
description: A coin that always lands on the side you need, not the side you expect. Passively boosts luck.

name: Void Shard
description: A fragment of something that should not exist within the System's framework. Humming with undefined potential.
flavor_text: The System has no entry for this.

name: Journeyman Hammer
description: A well-balanced smithing hammer with a double-lobe stamp mark and a V between the lobes — Torven's journeyman mark. Fifteen years of craft work in the grip.
flavor_text: A tool that remembers every shape it ever made.

name: Iron Compass Room Key
description: A brass key to Room 3 at the Iron Compass Inn. Good for one night.
flavor_text: It points nowhere, but it opens something.

name: Traveler's Bread
description: Dense, filling bread. Not fancy, but it keeps your arms working.

name: Roasted Meat
description: Salted and spit-roasted. Gives you the kind of strength that comes from eating well.

name: Traveler's Stew
description: Whatever's in season, cooked slow. Every stat gets a little boost.

name: Inn Meal
description: A proper sit-down meal at the inn. Restores HP and leaves you feeling sharp for a while.

name: Stamina Potion
description: Restores endurance and reduces fatigue.
backstory: Brewed from thornroot and cave moss. Bitter taste, quick effect.

name: Antidote
description: Cures poison and disease effects.
backstory: Standard alchemical recipe. The Guild keeps these stocked.

name: Resistance Potion
description: Temporarily reduces all incoming damage.
backstory: Developed after the Fracture when elemental anomalies began attacking registration checkpoints.

name: Travel Rations
description: Dried food. Prevents the hungry debuff.
backstory: Standard issue. The Guild packs three days' worth for every first contract.

name: Firewood Bundle
description: Needed for camping in the wilderness. Prevents cold debuff.

name: Forest Herb
description: A fragrant medicinal herb found near dungeon entrances and forest clearings. Used in basic healing preparations.
flavor_text: Smells like rain and green things.

name: Empty Vial
description: A small glass vial. Essential for storing alchemical preparations.
flavor_text: Only useful when filled with something.

name: Mountain Root
description: A gnarled root from high-altitude plants. Has strong regenerative properties when combined with herbs.
flavor_text: Takes ten years to grow. Worth every year.

name: Void Crystal Fragment
description: A small crystal shard that pulses with captured System energy. Found deep in the dungeon. The System cannot fully catalogue it.
flavor_text: Cold to the touch. Gets colder the more arcane energy surrounds it.

name: Herb Bundle
description: A wrapped bundle of dried mixed herbs. The standard alchemical base ingredient.
flavor_text: The alchemist on the east road sells these by the bundle.

name: Cooked Meat
description: Freshly cooked meat. Can be preserved as trail rations or eaten directly.
